notes.title: Updates and Delays: Our Exciting Journey Continues!
notes.notes:
Hello! This is the Enelia team speaking 🌺

It’s been quite some time since the release, and we've received a lot of feedback from players around the world. This feedback has given us a fresh perspective on our game and helped us understand the direction we should take moving forward. We want to thank everyone who has supported us all this time. You are the best ✨

So, what's next?

After carefully analyzing feedback from both players and industry professionals, we've put together a plan for a major update. This update will include improvements to the story, gameplay, localization, and many other small but pleasant enhancements.

Now for some sad news: the promised release of Chapter 2 will be delayed till Q4 2024😞 

This was not an easy decision for us, as we wanted to bring you the continuation as soon as possible! However, if we’re going to do an update, we want to do it right and meet your expectations 💪
But there’s another reason for the delay—a very good one, which we’ll be able to share with you soon 🤫

In the meantime, we hope for your understanding and thank you once again for staying with us.

Yours, Indra Studio 🌺

notes.title: Chapter 2 is coming!
notes.notes:
Chapter 2 is coming on August 16th!

Get ready to face the Madness itself—though this is just a taste. Can you withstand it?

But that’s not all. A new playable character, Ai'rin, is joining the adventure! Prepare to enter the ancient sanctuary of Sey'lim.

What secrets lie within? What dangers await?

In other news, we’re working on adding support for more languages. It's still early, so we can't say exactly when or which languages will be included, but stay tuned!

Thank you again for all your support. We can’t wait to share more with you soon!

Best wishes,
Indra Studio

notes.title: Play now! Madness is here... Enelia launches in Early Access!
notes.notes:
This day has finally come. Our game has launched in Early Access on Steam!

Our team is currently overwhelmed with mixed feelings. First and foremost, we are delighted that we have finally reached the point where the game becomes publicly available, and anyone can play it. Today, we will finally see the first results of our hard work.

We've said this before, but we'll say it again: we started making games to provide players with an unforgettable experience in a mysterious, original world. This has always been our main goal.

The journey has been long, especially for those who have been with the project since the first months. And although many joined us less than a year ago, they too have been eagerly awaiting this day. Of course, the most challenging part lies ahead, as we now need to continue with promotion, updates, and overall improvement and completion of the game. The project is not yet finished, and there's still a lot of exciting work ahead.

We want to thank everyone who has supported us, everyone who supports us now, and everyone who will support us in the future. We hope that the game will meet or even exceed your expectations if you, like us, love high-quality narrative adventures or visual novels.

Today, the world of Naouris has officially come to life. Deep down, we hope (as ambitious as it may sound) that this date will go down in the history of the gaming industry. This is our aspiration — for Enelia, as well as future projects, to have at least a minor impact on the industry, on other studios, and, of course, on players. After all, this is why we engage in creativity — to have a positive influence on the world and leave a mark.

No matter what, everything changes from today. We will continue to share news with you.

As always, we welcome your questions and comments.

notes.title: Madness is coming! On July 11th, Enelia is launching on Steam in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[h2]Enelia: Dawn of Madness is launching on Steam on 11th of July!
[/h2]
Enelia invites you into a world of terrifying secrets and revelations hidden in the shadows of Nauris city. Madness takes on human forms, yet it seems no one pays attention. The hearts of Za'ani people are shrouded in darkness. Could this be the reason why love is forbidden?

Desperation brings you closer to charming but mysterious characters whose encounters spark feelings you've never experienced before. Each of them will lead you to answers, but only if you are ready for the truth. 

How far will you go to uncover the true nature of Madness?

[h2]What is expecting you?[/h2]

[h3]Enchanting Atmosphere of an Uncharted World[/h3]
Nauris is a world brimming with dark mysteries and ancient secrets. Embark on a journey through this fantastical realm, encountering mythical creatures, witnessing magical landscapes, and exploring its most enigmatic depths.

[h3]Cinematic Storytelling[/h3]
A visual novel that blends various storytelling styles—animated backgrounds, illustrations, dynamic comics, and cinematic cutscenes. Enelia is more than just a visual novel.

[h3]Romantic Arcs[/h3]
Three enigmatic male characters—Salar, Boone, and Elris—cannot hide their feelings, despite the prohibition. But are you ready to reciprocate and uncover their terrifying secrets?

[h3]Role-Playing Elements[/h3]
One Madness meter, two playable characters, and three shades of the Divine Voice lead you to over five endings and dozens of hidden storylines.

[h3]Astral Vision[/h3]
Madness lurks in the shadows, only emerging when it gains enough strength. Only astral vision can detect its presence and influence on the world and its people. Use astral vision to stare true madness in the face.

[h3]Extraordinary World[/h3]
The world of Nauris is unlike any you know—no cosmos, no planets, no moon, and no oceans. No one knows what lies beyond the Secret Expanse or what the Heart of the World, sought by every druid, truly is. And where did the Seilims, the majestic and mysterious mythical beings that govern the forces of nature, come from?


Forge a strong bond with a beloved character or become their sworn enemy, do good and maintain harmony or walk the path of darkness and plunge the world into chaos.

The choice is yours - follow the call of your heart or dive into the very heart of Madness?
